note: v0.2.0 real-play validation of the hitch guard (docs/202; Rodney 2026-10-26: no special repro for phase A cuts, long unseen plans are common in real play). Natural play, no repro, seed 12345, IP and SV, both-order pairs on/off/off/on as separate 15 min loads per world, timing (noiseCheck). Both arms: all12 asi (0.36.102, + ArenaGuard InitobjFix, docs/67 §22.9), release defaults, ArenaGuard TailPad, kind deadlines + PlanDeadlineMs 300 + FallbackAsync (FbJobCapMs 300, FbJobDeadline), spread fixes easpreadlots/pets/decay + overwatchstuckslice, light tools as natural-shipped. Arm = the hitch guard: [UnseenFallback] Enabled/DeadlineMs 300/Sites/SiteWaitMs 100 + ts3fixes unseenfbstuck/plan/teleport/sites/pre/arrive/leave; routingFailFast {300, unseen} on ON arms only. Verdict: hitch-ab.ts --causes off vs on per world, routing-led >= 200/250/300/1000 ms per 10 min against the docs/202 ~50% target. Smoke first (repo rule).

smoke.note: Measurement smoke: IP 10 min with the ON-arm config (all11 asi, full v0.2.0 routing set + hitch guard + spread fixes): every switch reads back (fixes on: ... verified), the stubs and C sites install (ufReady >= 14, ufcReady 63), kdReady 1, the per-minute 'unseen fallback:' / 'unseen fallback sites:' / 'route kind deadlines' lines appear, noise split works. No ufMarks requirement (checks the measurement path, not the feature).

jobs.note: ON half 1 (Isla Paradiso, ABBA on/off/off/on, separate loads): 15 min natural play (autopilot, camera untouched, no repro, seed 12345), all12 asi (0.36.102, + ArenaGuard InitobjFix, docs/67 §22.9) at release defaults + the full v0.2.0 routing set: kind deadlines + PlanDeadlineMs 300 + FallbackAsync/FbJobCapMs 300/FbJobDeadline (as untested-v020 ip-v020-routing-31), spread fixes (easpreadlots,easpreadpets,easpreaddecay,overwatchstuckslice), and the hitch guard: [UnseenFallback] Enabled=1 DeadlineMs=300 (strict) Sites=1 SiteWaitMs=100 + ts3fixes unseenfbstuck,unseenfbplan,unseenfbteleport,unseenfbsites,unseenfbpre,unseenfbarrive,unseenfbleave (docs/202 phases A, B, C1-C4, D, D-arrive/leave). Pass: no crash, 0 watchdog lines, no Sim stuck at the end, ufMarks > 0 (the guard acts in real play), unseenfb_refused 0 (unseenfb_seen = plans of seen Sims passed to the game unchanged: info, grows in natural play), kdReady 1, pdCutSc 0. Report, not required > 0: ufSyncCut, ufJobCut, ufLong, ufcTry_0..3 / ufcFake_0..3, unseenfb_marked / _cut / _noretry, unseenfbteleport_shortcuts / _no_spot, unseenfbpre_*, unseenfbarrive_* / unseenfbleave_*, unseenfb_max_ms.
